description: The current issues with Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) in West Virginia are almost comical, if not for the fact that thousands of needy children and their families are being harmed by it.The TANF funds in question come from the federal government, and it appears West Virginia is not being a good steward for those funds.
